analysis.title: GS - Eid - Vol Views - 5 Nov 2026
key_insights: Vol was crushed after the midterms as event premium left the surface. GS's Panic Index posted its second largest 1-day drop in the last 20 years.
The desk sees large tails from here. GS's CTA model projects $164bn of SPX selling in a down-tape and $130bn of buying in an up-tape over the next month.
Net exposures are still near lows, so the desk favors using options for protection in either direction and prefers SPX over NDX.
The implied move through the rest of the week is 0.80%, with geopolitical overhangs still topical as earnings season winds down.
A semis to hyperscalers rotation was the most prominent theme under the hood. The 1-day return spread between GSXUHYPR and GSTMTDAT was the second largest on record, behind only Deepseek Monday.
The desk reads the move as the market treating lower spending on new capacity as a positive, reviving hopes for a stronger free-cash-flow outlook.
GS PB data shows Mag7 positioning reset to the 55th percentile vs the past year in late October, which opens room to add length.
About 78% of S&P market cap will have reported by this weekend, with EPS growth on track for 33% YoY.
The median stock that beats EPS estimates has outperformed the S&P 500 by 152bps the day after reporting, vs a historical median of 95bps. Beats among TMT stocks have generally gone unrewarded.
Skew relaxed meaningfully across indices. The VIX futures curve shifted lower and reverted to contango, and VVIX fell 17 points as investors monetized hedges.
SPX vol continues to screen more attractive than NDX vol on an absolute basis.
